children.text: Here is a function that processes an array:
Let's look at the generated assembly:

html.text:
process_values():
    vpbroadcastb    xmm1, byte ptr [rip + .LCPI0_1]
    vmovd   xmm2, dword ptr [rsi + rax]
    vpandn  xmm2, xmm2, xmm1
    add     rax, 4
    cmp     r8, rax
    jne     .LBB0_6

children.text: The compiler generates vectorized code that processes four values at a time.
